chunks: Have you seen him who denies the Day of Judgement?
ai.seo_question: Who is the person that denies the Day of Judgement according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited as the opening of Surah Al-Ma'arij (70:1), serves as a rhetorical challenge to the Prophet Muhammad regarding the arrogant disbelievers of Mecca who denied the Day of Judgment. In Shia exegesis, this denial is viewed not merely as intellectual skepticism but as a moral failure rooted in the rejection of divine accountability (Hisab) and recompense (Jaza), which are central to the concept of Adl (Divine Justice). The verse highlights the psychological state of those who dismiss the Hereafter, setting the stage for the description of their eventual ascent to the Fire.
